description: Defines the data structure 'LoanProductInterestRecalculationData' for representing interest recalculation parameters of a loan product in the Fineract system.

classes.name: LoanProductInterestRecalculationData
classes.description: A data class encapsulating interest recalculation settings for a loan product, including frequency, strategy, and flags.

methods.name: sensibleDefaultsForNewLoanProductCreation
methods.description: Provides default values for creating a new loan product interest recalculation configuration.

methods.name: isArrearsBasedOnOriginalSchedule
methods.description: Returns whether interest is arrears-based on the original schedule.

methods.name: isCompoundingToBePostedAsTransaction
methods.description: Returns whether interest compounding should be posted as a transaction.

methods.name: disallowInterestCalculationOnPastDue
methods.description: Returns whether interest calculation on past due is disallowed.
